name: IRIS eye semantic segmentation model reference
description: Model-card reference describing an infrared-eye segmentation network based on UNet++ with a MobileNetV2 encoder and scSE blocks, predicting eyeball, iris, pupil and eyelashes classes. Model weights are acquired separately by the inference adapters.

metadata.semantic_review: Verified from pinned source; runtime not tested
dependencies: Compatible ONNX Runtime or TensorRT adapter
metadata.overlap: A separately callable IRIS algorithm or subsystem. Compose through the package's IRImage/GeometryPolygons/IrisTemplate contracts; types, callbacks and mathematical helpers are shared dependencies. This is biometric processing, not a complete authorized identity service.
metadata.artifact_scope: Pinned model documentation only; external model weights/revision/license were not independently verified or downloaded.
metadata.deployment_warning: Verify the separately acquired weight artifact, revision, terms and performance for the intended input population before deployment.
